entities.summary: Valery Aleksandrovich Golubev is a Russian politician and businessman. He is a former Head of the Vasileostrovsky Administrative District of St. Petersburg, former member of the Federation Council of Russia, and a Deputy CEO Gazprom and the Head of its Department for Construction and Investment. He retired in 2019.
